content:
sarah: customer reported sharp p99 spike in tool-calls yesterday after we rolled out schema-validator v2 at 03:12 UTC. customer says page load for tool-assisted flows jumped from ~350ms to ~1.6s. attaching repro steps and a short trace link.

sarah: repro steps: 1) call /v1/tool-router with toolchain of 3 tools (parse->lookup->format) 2) attach schema for format tool (complex nested JSON schema) 3) run with small inputs (avg 128 tokens) 4) observe p95/p99 increase. trace: https://internal.traces/4590001234

mike: looking. did we enable strict JSONPath checks in validator v2? last change added full-schema compile per-request instead of cached compiled validators.

jess: yes — v2 switched to ajv compile on first use but we moved to per-request compile for safety (bug in shared-cache). that explains CPU/time. should have fallback but looks like tool-router calls are synchronous and waiting on validation.

rahul: infra-bot shows spike correlated with validator traffic: CPU up ~40% on router hosts, long queue times on worker pool. snippet from host logs:
```
2026-03-15T03:15:22Z tool-router[worker-7] validate schema compile duration=410ms schema_id=fmt-v2
2026-03-15T03:15:22Z tool-router[worker-7] handler total duration=1180ms request_id=rcpt-44a
```

mike: ok that 410ms per compile multiplies badly with cold-cache and small batched requests. two quick questions: can we 1) revert per-request compile to cached compile, or 2) short-circuit validation for simple tool contracts until we stabilize?

jess: cache fix is straightforward, I can open a patch to use LRU compiled validator with a TTL. mitigation idea: for formats flagged "trusted" skip deep schema validation and do a lightweight structural check instead.

sarah: customer on the line — recommended immediate mitigation?

rahul: emergency mitigation path: add feature-flag to router that disables schema compile for the request path. we can flip it per-customer until patch lands. I'll create a hotpatch.

mike: also recommend increasing internal timeout on tool calls to avoid cascading 504s while we patch. but that's bandaid.

jess: planned patch: add compiled-validator LRU (default size 1024), TTL 10m, and a fast-path that checks top-level keys only for trusted tools. will send PR in 30m.

sarah: customer accepts feature-flag route. please add rollout notes and expected impact.

rahul: infra-bot scheduled a canary rollout for the flag to 1 host in us-west-2 in 5m. monitoring: p50/p95/p99 and queue depth on router-hosts.

infra-bot: deploy-started service=tool-router env=prod region=us-west-2 canary=1

mike: follow-up action items: (1) jess PR for LRU+fastpath, (2) rahul hotpatch flag + rollback plan, (3) ops extend tool timeout by 200ms, (4) support notify customer @sarah. I'll own verification.

jess: PR opened: https://internal.git/infra/tool-router/pull/892 — includes benchmarks, reduces compile tail by 90% in local repro.

rahul: hotpatch applied to canary, initial metrics: p99 dropped from ~1.6s to ~420ms on canary host, CPU normalized. rolling to 10%.

sarah: customer confirmed latency improved on their region. asked for timeline for full fix.

mike: ETA for full rollout after verification: 2-3 hours depending on canary. long-term: rework schema validation to precompile at ingestion time for model/tool manifests and store compiled validators in K/V.

sarah: thanks all — will update the customer and close the escalation once we hit steady-state metrics for 1h.

mike: note for postmortem: include why cache was disabled, add a regression test for schema-validator performance under small-batch tool calls.

jess: adding perf regression tests to CI, and a new synthetic load that exercises nested schema validation.

infra-bot: deploy-success service=tool-router env=prod region=us-west-2 canary=10

rahul: metrics stable after 35m of roll (p95 down 300-600ms, p99 down ~1.1s). rolling to 100% now.

sarah: customer closed ticket with positive feedback. closing thread after PM approves postmortem draft.
